title: Connect resource links on the Resources page

requirements.summary: Connect four downloadable/external resource items in the Resources page to their respective URLs, opening each in a new tab with proper security attributes
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking the वैदिक दर्शन का परिचय item/button on the Resources page navigates to https://share.google/ofFQSRZ1FTsdJB8Op in a new tab.
Clicking the दैनिक प्रार्थना संग्रह item/button on the Resources page navigates to https://adipurgroup.wordpress.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/e0a4b8e0a4ade0a4be.pdf in a new tab.

Clicking the त्योहार कैलेंडर और अनुष्ठान item/button on the Resources page navigates to https://calendarhindu.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/Hindu-Calendar-2026-With-Tithi-in-Hindi-PDF-Download.pdf in a new tab.
Clicking the भगवद गीता अध्ययन मार्गदर्शिका item/button on the Resources page navigates to https://www.rupanugabhajanashram.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/11/Bhagavad-Gita-Hindi.pdf in a new tab.
All four links include target="_blank" and rel="noopener noreferrer" attributes.

file_operations.description: Add href attributes to the four resource items in the downloadable materials section: (1) वैदिक दर्शन का परिचय linking to https://share.google/ofFQSRZ1FTsdJB8Op; (2) दैनिक प्रार्थना संग्रह linking to https://adipurgroup.wordpress.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/e0a4b8e0a4ade0a4be.pdf; (3) त्योहार कैलेंडर और अनुष्ठान linking to https://calendarhindu.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/Hindu-Calendar-2026-With-Tithi-in-Hindi-PDF-Download.pdf; (4) भगवद गीता अध्ययन मार्गदर्शिका linking to https://www.rupanugabhajanashram.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/11/Bhagavad-Gita-Hindi.pdf. Each link must include target="_blank" and rel="noopener noreferrer" attributes. Do not modify any other content, layout, or styling on the page.
